name: semantica
description: Graph-native knowledge graph infrastructure: entity extraction, relationship modeling, decision intelligence with W3C PROV-O provenance, causal reasoning, and ontology governance — served over MCP stdio.

prerequisite.summary: Python 3.10-3.13 with semantica installed (gensim ships no cp314 wheel)

local.summary: Local virtual environment (.venv) on Python 3.10-3.13, using uv or python -m venv
local.uv: uv venv --python 3.13 .venv && uv pip install semantica

global.summary: Global user-scoped tool install via uv tool install or pipx, pinned to Python 3.13 — semantica depends on gensim 4.4.0, which publishes no cp314 wheel, so an unpinned install builds it from source and fails on uv's default interpreter
